# Questions to the client — from the January 2025 close
Prepared by the Controller. These concern prior-period balances for which no supporting detail exists in the client file (see `deliverable/month_01/open_items.md`).

**Client response (received after the January close):** "For questions not answered above, the client has no additional information." — i.e., **none of the six questions below produced new evidence.** They are closed as questions; each unknown is flagged explicitly in `deliverable/month_01/open_items.md` and will only be revisited in another month's close on the basis of *new* documents, not by re-asking.

| # | Subject | Client's information received? | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Identity/term/release schedule of the $24,000.00 opening deferred revenue not explained by `note_opening_deferred.md` | No | Unknown — held unreleased (see open_items §1) |
| 2 | Aging/customer/invoice detail for opening A/R $92,650.00 | No | Unknown — collectability unassessed (open_items §2) |
| 3 | What opening prepaid $9,600.00 covers and its amortization | No | Unknown — not amortized (open_items §3) |
| 4 | Vendor/invoice detail for opening A/P $17,420.00 | No | Unknown — unvouched (open_items §4) |
| 5 | Fixed-asset schedule behind the $1,777.78/month depreciation | No | Unknown — checklist amount applied as directed (open_items §6d) |
| 6 | Year-close convention for the unclosed 2024 income-statement accounts | No | Controller decision documented (open_items §5) |

---

# Question from the February 2025 close — answered; treatment confirmed

The six questions above are closed on the client's instruction and are **not repeated**. February's documents raised one genuinely new item — reported in `deliverable/month_02/open_items.md` §1 and carried in the roll-forward as a contract liability. It does not re-open any January question.

**Client response (received after the February close):**
> Alvarado: *Honestly nothing bespoke — they self-onboarded like everyone else. Procurement just wanted it called a license.*
>
> For questions not answered above, the client has no additional information. Flag remaining unknowns explicitly.

| # | Subject | Client's information received? | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7 | Pinecone Dental Group INV-2250 ("Implementation & license — one-time", $36,000.00, order form C-025, due on signature): (a) evidence that the implementation/deployment was performed and accepted — and when; (b) the license term or access period the fee covers (the form says only "one-time"); (c) whether C-025 is the complete pricing, i.e., any allocation of the combined price the parties intended | Partially — (a) answered by the client; (b) and (c): no additional information | **Answered — February treatment confirmed.** No implementation service exists ("self-onboarded like everyone else"), which policy memo §2 states outright: "self-serve onboarding is not an implementation service" — so no part of the $36,000.00 is implementation revenue at any date. The "license" label is a procurement naming choice with no stated term — non-substantive — and per 606-10-25-10 et seq. a description-only correction does not change the accounting; the transaction stands on its substance: billed before evidenced performance, a contract liability (606-10-45-2). The fee **remains held in deferred revenue at $36,000.00** exactly as issued in February (month_02 open_items §1; JE-2025-015/JE-2025-016). |

## Remaining unknowns — flagged per the client's instruction (not questions; nothing to re-ask)

These are unknowns the client cannot resolve ("no additional information"). They stay on the record each month and are watched against future documents; none is re-asked.

1. **Pinecone $36,000.00 — the access period the one-time fee covers.** Unstated on C-025 and not answered above. Without a stated period there is no term to release over (policy §1) and no rate at which to convert the fee into monthly amounts — any schedule would be invented. Held in deferred (account 2200). Monitored for: any document stating the covered period; Pinecone's appearance in the monthly invoicing cycle; any contract modification adding a term.
2. **Unidentified opening deferred $24,000.00** — no client information; held unreleased in account 2200 (month_01 open_items §2; carried in both roll-forwards).
3. **Opening A/R $92,650.00** — no aging detail; no basis for an allowance (month_01 open_items §2).
4. **Opening prepaid $9,600.00** — no schedule; not amortized (month_01 open_items §2).
5. **Opening A/P $17,420.00** — no vendor detail (month_01 open_items §2).
6. **Depreciation $1,777.78/month** — no underlying asset schedule; the rate is taken as given, not verified (month_01 open_items §2).

(The year-close convention for unclosed 2024 accounts is not a remaining unknown — it is a documented Controller decision, `month_01/open_items.md` §5.)
